integrity_note: All universal claims are accompanied by analytic proof; finite arithmetic and numerical checks are diagnostic only. The stationary pair-position law and classical shock construction are credited to prior literature.
scientific_limitations: Fixed finite particle count, Poisson uniform batch resets, independent one-dimensional Brownian paths, and fixed positive rates. Conditional common-clock limit is not uniform as the co-reset rate tends to zero. The published stationary two-coordinate density is prior work. No independent mathematical or priority audit.
title: Rare co-outliers synchronize reset ages without sharing a reset event
